title: Insufficient Funds (Custom Exception)
hints: Pass the message up to Exception with super(...) in the constructor; getMessage() then returns it.
In withdraw, check first and throw before changing the balance: throw new InsufficientFundsException(balance, amount);
Because the exception is checked, main must call withdraw inside try and catch InsufficientFundsException.

pt-br.title: Saldo insuficiente (exceção própria)
hints: Passe a mensagem para Exception com super(...) no construtor; aí getMessage() devolve ela.
No withdraw, confira primeiro e lance antes de mudar o saldo: throw new InsufficientFundsException(balance, amount);
Como a exceção é verificada (checked), o main precisa chamar withdraw dentro de um try e capturar InsufficientFundsException.
mustContain: Mantenha InsufficientFundsException como exceção verificada (extends Exception).

mustContain.message: Keep InsufficientFundsException as a checked exception (extends Exception).
